stratagems.name: Cunning of the Wolf
stratagems.target: One SPACE WOLVES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, add 1 to Charge rolls made for your unit. In addition, after your unit's charge move, you can choose one enemy unit your unit is now within Engagement Range of; that enemy unit cannot fire Overwatch this turn.

stratagems.name: Wolf Guard
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or Fight phase, just after an enemy unit has selected its targets.
stratagems.target: One SPACE WOLVES WOLF GUARD TERMINATOR unit from your army that was selected as a target.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets your unit, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack (min 1).

stratagems.name: Tempest's Wrath
stratagems.target: One SPACE WOLVES unit from your army that made a charge move or was charged this turn.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, models in your unit have the Fights First ability.

stratagems.name: Keen Senses
stratagems.target: One SPACE WOLVES unit from your army.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the phase, your unit can target units that are not visible to it. When doing so, subtract 1 from all Hit rolls.
